# Pals Academy

> Pals Academy is a kindergarten in Waithaka, Nairobi, Kenya, offering Baby Class, PP1 and PP2. Its motto is "A Home of First Friendship". It is part of the Pals Group of Companies.

- Location: Waithaka, next to St Parthenios Orthodox Church, Nairobi, Kenya
- Phone and WhatsApp: +254 757 319 665
- Email: enroll@palsacademy.co.ke
- Classes: Baby Class, PP1 (Pre-Primary 1), PP2 (Pre-Primary 2)
- Head Teacher: Mr Mbwaya
- School transport is run by sister company Pals Travel & Leisure (https://palstravelleisure.co.ke)
- Fees, places and admission dates are confirmed directly by the school and are not published on the website.
